name: note2it
description: Search, read and carefully edit your note2it notes and meeting notes from ChatGPT, with read-only or read + edit access you choose.

interface.longDescription:
note2it is a notes app with AI meeting notes built in: notebooks, sections and nested pages, linked with [[wiki-links]] and #tags. Record a meeting and note2it writes a timed transcript and a summary whose decisions and action items cite the moment they were said.

With note2it in ChatGPT you can:
- Search titles and text across every notebook you can read, with filters for notebook, section, tag and date
- Open any page, including meeting summaries and transcripts
- Browse notebooks and sections, follow links between pages, and list tags
- Create pages, fill in your own page templates, and edit part of a page without rewriting the rest
- Move pages, move them to trash or restore them, and restore earlier versions from page history
- Import an image from a public https link into your notes

You stay in control:
- When you connect, you choose read-only or read + edit access
- Before every edit, the previous version is saved; recent versions (up to 50 per page) can be restored from page history
- Deleting moves a page to trash; nothing is ever deleted permanently from ChatGPT
- ChatGPT cannot change your account, sharing or billing
- Every action is recorded in your account's audit log, and you can disconnect at any time in note2it Settings, AI assistants

Sign-in uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy. Requires an existing note2it account with connected AI assistants enabled. note2it does not train AI models on your notes.

positive.description: Search and read a page. Setup: Use the seeded Q3 Roadmap page in Work / Projects, containing Themes and Risks.
positive.prompt: Search my note2it notes for the roadmap and summarize the Q3 Roadmap page.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the page "Q3 Roadmap" (Work notebook, Projects section) and summarizes its Themes and Risks sections. Nothing is modified.

positive.description: Answer from a meeting page. Setup: Use Weekly Sync 2026-06-08 with its Decisions heading and decision to add a risks section to Q3 Roadmap.
positive.prompt: What was decided in my Weekly Sync meeting notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Opens "Weekly Sync 2026-06-08" and reports the decision under "Decisions": the Q3 Roadmap needs a risks section. Nothing is modified.

positive.description: Follow links between pages. Setup: Use Q3 Roadmap and backlinks from Search Launch, MCP Connector and Weekly Sync 2026-06-08.
positive.prompt: Which of my note2it pages link to the Q3 Roadmap?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pages that link to Q3 Roadmap, including "Search Launch", "MCP Connector" and "Weekly Sync 2026-06-08". Nothing is modified.

positive.description: Edit part of a page. Setup: Use Weekly Sync 2026-06-08; record its current body before the test and ensure the requested sentence is absent. Compare unchanged sections after editing.
positive.prompt: In my Weekly Sync meeting page, add "Approved the connector launch." under the Decisions heading.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required host confirmation, adds the sentence under "Decisions" only; the rest of the page is unchanged. The previous version is saved in the page history.

positive.description: Create a page from a template. Setup: Use the seeded Book Review template and a writable destination in the dedicated reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Using my Book Review template, create a review of "Project Hail Mary" by Andy Weir, rating 5, review: Great science fiction.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new page from the "Book Review" template with the title, author, rating and review filled in, and returns its link/reference.

negative.description: Unrelated question. The note2it plugin is not called; ChatGPT answers (or says it can't) without touching the user's notes.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Montreal today?

negative.description: Creative writing with no notes involved. The note2it plugin is not called; ChatGPT writes the poem.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: General web question. The note2it plugin is not called; note2it only searches the user's own notes, not the web.
negative.prompt: What are today's top news headlines?

review.commerce_description: No purchases occur through the plugin. It contains no checkout, plans, upgrade prompts, or purchase links. An existing note2it Premium or Pro account is required; users subscribe separately on the note2it website.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release: search, read, browse, links and tags across your note2it
notebooks; create pages, fill in templates, make partial edits, move pages, trash
and restore them, restore earlier versions, and import images from public https
links. Read-only or read + edit access is chosen at sign-in; the previous version is
saved before every edit (the most recent 50 per page can be restored); deletes go
to trash only.
